description_en: Cancels a scheduled restart for a specific community-compatible ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用CancelRestartInstance接口取消指定云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群的预约重启时间
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse cancel-restart-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp1t9lbb7a4z70000 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelRestartInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query information about all clusters in a specific region. The information includes the cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The scheduled restart time. The time must be in the \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ\` format and in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 预约重启的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: restart_time
